note: One statement a day for residents to agree or disagree with. Each comes from an open issue and is worded neutrally (rules in UPDATE.md). Only questions with status "approved" are shown. Results are what participants said, not what residents want.

questions.text: Conway's zoning rewrite should make room for more housing near the villages and limit big box development.
Conway should cap how much the school district's property tax can grow for the next two years.
The Rec Path should be extended through Whitaker Woods to Intervale, paid for with grants and donations.
The landfill's users should pay for the North Conway Water Precinct's $8 million treatment of PFAS in landfill leachate.
Bartlett should allow the proposed gravel pit off Route 16.
Bartlett's updated Master Plan should allow AI data centers in town, with conditions.
Jackson should offer property tax relief (RSA 79-E) to owners who fix up buildings in the village.
Commercial fireworks in Jackson should be allowed only in the Village District.
Madison should replace the Silver Lake dam now, even if federal money does not come through.
Carroll County's emergency radio equipment should be allowed to stay on the Eidelweiss tower site.
Tamworth should keep asking the state for a four-way stop at Routes 16 and 113 in Chocorua.
Madison should allow a snowmobile crossing at the Silver Lake Dam.
Madison should update its Master Plan, the long-range guide for land use, housing, roads and conservation.
Bartlett's school buses should park on a nearby private lot, with the town's Highway Department plowing and maintaining it.
Bartlett voters should create a flood reserve fund for work such as the Dugway berm on the upper Saco River.
Conway voters should adopt the rewritten Zoning Ordinance and zoning map at the 2027 Town Meeting.
The state should add the four-way stop at Routes 16 and 113 in Chocorua that the Tamworth Select Board asked for.
Madison should keep adding money to its Silver Lake Dam trust fund while it waits to hear about federal funding for a new dam.
Jackson should keep requiring a conditional use permit for every short-term rental.
Bartlett should go ahead with the town-wide property revaluation planned for 2027.
Tamworth's Master Plan update should start with housing, as the Planning Board has begun to do.
Bartlett should keep requiring the new road in the Stillings Grant Block G subdivision to meet town road standards.
When Main Street Project work resumes in 2027, Conway should keep two-way traffic with flaggers instead of detouring traffic onto side streets.
